argv:
A Meridian-3 has stopped reporting. How long can it keep working
offline, and how would I detect that from the Fleet Control API?

parsed.answer:
A Meridian-3 can keep executing its buffered task queue for up to **12 minutes** after losing its network link to Fleet Control — this is its offline autonomy window, which is fixed in firmware and not configurable. [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Meridian-3 Autonomous Mobile Robot > Offline Autonomy]

To detect this from the Fleet Control API:

1. **Watch `link_state`**: Poll `GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry`. A `link_state` of `offline` means no report has been received for more than 30 seconds. [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry]

2. **Monitor `offline_seconds`**: This field counts up from the last successful report. When it crosses the 12-minute (720-second) offline autonomy window, you can assume a safe-park has almost certainly occurred — the robot makes that decision on board, so Fleet Control cannot confirm it while the robot is offline. [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry] [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Meridian-3 Autonomous Mobile Robot > Offline Autonomy]

3. **Listen for webhooks**: You will receive a `robot.link_lost` event when connectivity drops. On reconnect, `robot.link_restored` fires, and if the robot did safe-park, a `robot.safe_parked` event and an amber `beacon` will appear. [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?]

4. **Check `beacon`**: After reconnect, a `beacon` value of `amber` confirms the robot safe-parked. If the beacon stays amber for more than a minute after reconnect, a physical check is needed — no manual intervention is required otherwise, as the robot resumes on its own. [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?] [sample_corpus/support-runbook.md:Support Runbook > Many Robots Offline at Once]
